search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail ListBuckets 
| json "eventSource", "eventName", "errorCode" nodrop 
| where eventSource="s3.amazonaws.com" and eventName="ListBuckets" and isBlank(errorCode) 
| count as count 
| "S3_ListBuckets" as benchmarkname 
| "EventCount" as type 
| fillmissing values("S3_ListBuckets") in benchmarkname, values("EventCount") in type 
| toInt(count) as count
